test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the italicised word.

*Colossal* granite obelisks were erected by only a few kings.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gigantic**__**.**

The italicised word in the given sentence is Colossal.

The most appropriate synonym of Colossal is 'extremely large or great.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lilliputian - A trivial or very small person or thing.
 
• Minute - Extremely small in size.
 
• Minuscule - Extremely small.
